name: Trish Keller
headline: Chief Technology Officer of Citizen Watch America (Retired)

experiences.companyName: Citizen Watch Company of America, Inc.
experiences.description: Lead remarkable team of IT professionals in executing corporate strategy.
Implemented SAP ERP- ECC, CRM and WCEM. Managed warehouse operations.
Responsible for all aspects of IT for a best in class B2B, B2C and CPG business. Built strong team of IT professionals to provide business solutions with a focus on internal customer service.

experiences.position: Director, IT Engineering and Customer Support
experiences.description: Responsible for IT technical services for national retailer.  Scope included geographically diverse point of sale, warehouse and corporate help desks; engineering, computer operations and multiple data centers.  Accountable for PCI and SOX compliance.

Built and maintained district wide area network connecting seven locations. Established budget and procured funds through grants and E-Rate; accountable for all IT investment spending for capital and operating expenses.
